name: Glossyleaf manzanita
desc: Glossyleaf manzanita (Arctostaphylos nummularia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 37 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Arctostaphylos nummularia is a species of manzanita known by the common names glossyleaf manzanita, dwarf manzanita and Fort Bragg manzanita.
